fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the upcoming Miami municipal election and city commissioner candidates (including Ev Sewell, Cliff Reeder, Red/ Judge Gautier, Harry Platt, Abe Aronovitz, and Jimmie Donn), urging voters to oppose banker-backed candidates and criticizing bond issues and utility influence (Florida Power & Light). Coverage also addresses gambling and the pari-mutuel racing bill (including discussion of anti-racing advocate Marcus A. Milam), Everglades fires and political criticism of Governor John Martin, a satirical piece on a proposed new Miami Beach county, local civic notes, and advertisements and political ads.
